zh-CN.name: REA 逆向分析
zh-CN.summary: 基于证据分析二进制、软件包与应用行为。需另备受支持的 Node.js/npm、rea-agents CLI 或已注册的 REA MCP；原生分析、抓包与信号记录等流程需另备目标相关工具及权限，Hopper、IDA、Fiddler Everywhere 等商业提供方须另行授权付费；代为操作浏览器前须获授权。安装本技能仅提供指引，不安装工具或注册服务；依赖不可用时先处理阻碍，不编造结果。

en-US.name: REA: Reverse Engineer Anything
en-US.summary: Evidence-led reverse analysis of binaries, packages and app behavior. Requires supported Node.js/npm and rea-agents CLI or a registered REA MCP server; target-specific tools, permissions and any commercial provider licenses (e.g. Hopper, IDA, Fiddler Everywhere) are separate. Agent-driven browser actions need operator authorization. Installing this skill only supplies instructions; it does not install tools or register services. Resolve missing dependencies before claiming results.

requirements.value: 需 Node.js ^22.19.0 || ^24.11.0 || >=26.0.0 及 npm；SQLite 快照检查另需 Node.js 24.15+ 或 26+。Requires the supported Node.js range and npm; SQLite snapshot inspection needs Node.js 24.15+ or 26+.

另备 rea-agents CLI；MCP 工作流需另注册 REA MCP，并核对实际工具列表/版本。上游恢复流程可运行 `npx -y rea-agents@latest`（下载最新 npm 包并写入 npm 缓存），仅在运营者审阅 dry-run 计划并批准后才写入客户端配置、替换捆绑技能或安装 Hopper。This skill neither installs REA nor registers an MCP server; setup writes only after an approved dry-run plan.

目标相关工具另备，例如原生分析 Hopper/Ghidra/IDA/Kuna，Android JADX/JDK/adb，固件 Binwalk/Unblob，抓包记录 Wireshark 4.x tshark/capinfos，信号记录 sigrok-cli，WASM 用 WABT。Target-specific tools and their supported hosts are separate (recorded packet/signal decoding needs Linux prlimit); commercial Hopper/IDA/JEB and Fiddler Everywhere (live traffic via its own MCP server) require their own licenses and costs.

仅分析已获授权的目标；运行时操作需相应系统权限与授权。代理执行浏览器场景（点击/输入/导航）前须获运营者授权：连接模式会重新导航所选页面并可能丢失未保存状态，优先用临时配置的启动模式。抓包与信号工具只读已有记录。Use authorized targets; get approval before agent-driven browser actions. Resolve unavailable dependencies or stop before unsupported calls; never fabricate results.
